title: The Book, lit for the second parent
note: The sheet closes onto the welcome, which hands over to the Book and leaves first run behind; the Book is on this book, and its light rises from unlit over 1.2 s, the one slow arrival outside first run (5.8 row 12).
text: Asha's book Asha From Papa The first page is waiting. Tell Asha one thing about today. Write a letter Tonight Book Family
lines: Tell Asha one thing about today.
